items.title: Restriction of scalars along a map of sheaves of rings preserves K-injectivity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that restricting scalars along a map O -> O' of sheaves of rings on a site turns a K-injective complex of O-modules into a K-injective complex of O'-modules when packaged as SheafHom_O(O', I^bullet) (statement lines 4615-4622). The proof is a single adjunction identification: K-injectivity is tested through homotopy classes of maps from complexes of O'-modules, and the adjunction rewrites those groups as homotopy classes of maps over O into the K-injective I^bullet, whose vanishing in the acyclic case is the hypothesis (proof lines 4625-4629). The content is the choice of the right adjunction. The claim is H2: one identification of hom groups, with the adjunction coming from another chapter.
